svg.title: Runtime workload protocol
svg.desc: A whole-family hard safety guard applies to every primary arm and the soak. The default ceiling is 2048 MiB; budgets above 2048 MiB are rejected on this 16 GiB host. The first sample above budget terminates the test daemon, stops new command dispatch and preserves raw samples, abort reason and all planned tasks in the denominator. Sampling may overshoot by one interval; sampler failure itself also aborts. The 128 MiB deliberately low-ceiling baseline probe proves cleanup/abort plumbing; its peak is not a performance result. The soak samples the guard every second, streams guard samples to disk and retains one guard sample in memory. It never launches automatically.
